branchSurvey.scope: Every nonsymmetric legal alternative at first2 authored peak decision states / first1 base decision state. Not all game states.

structuralProxy.algorithm: See each row: actionable limited-slot leader priorities,2+lower uncovering transfers,or use-vs-bury waste. Other states are unclassified/routine, not proven forced. This is not a measure of thought or fun.

summary.limits: Replays prove correctness of the supplied routes. Independent and restricted searches are bounded; UNKNOWN is not an impossibility proof. Sampled branches are not exhaustive. No human enjoyment, win rate, retention, native feel or balance acceptance has been measured.
